message.content:
Now I understand the vulnerability. In `parse_primitive`, the code calls `strtol(str_val, &endp, 10)` and `atof(str_val)` where `str_val = js + tokens[*index].start`. These functions expect a null-terminated string, but the JSON input may not be null-terminated. If the primitive token is at the very end of the input buffer (no null terminator), `strtol`/`atof` will read past the buffer boundary, causing an OOB read.

Let me look at the fuzzer to understand how input is provided.
